NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Allow standalone install (split-less APK)
patches.description: Removes Pdb's base-APK split requirement (requiredSplitTypes=base__abi,base__density) so the single patched APK installs. Required when patching the App Bundle's base APK.

patches.name: Bypass PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables Pdb's PairIP / Play licence verification so the app runs after Morphe re-signs it. Restores the real Application class (pdb.app.App).

patches.name: Disable AppsFlyer
patches.description: Neutralizes AppsFlyer attribution/telemetry: the SDK is never initialized or started, and the JS bridge reports success as usual.

patches.name: Disable CleverTap
patches.description: Stops CleverTap session/activity tracking and push-click attribution. Push notifications themselves keep working.

patches.name: Disable Firebase Performance + installer check
patches.description: Makes Firebase Performance's connection wrapper a pass-through (no perf telemetry) and reports installs as Play-installed regardless of the actual installer.

patches.name: Disable PairIP license check
patches.description: Disables PairIP license verification, VM checks, and repeated background checks.

patches.name: Disable SSL pinning
patches.description: Removes certificate pinning at both layers (OkHttp pin comparison and the platform network-security-config pin-set) and trusts user-installed CAs, so HTTPS traffic can be inspected with a MITM proxy. Normal TLS validation stays intact.

patches.name: Disable security checks
patches.description: Stops MyDialog from exiting itself on root/debug/emulator/adb detection and on Play Integrity failure. Signature verification is reported clean so patched builds pass.

patches.name: Disable trackers
patches.description: Disables Google Analytics measurement and Facebook SDK auto-init, and turns off Firebase Analytics/AdID data collection via their official opt-out flags.

patches.name: Disable trackers
patches.description: Disables Google Analytics measurement and Yandex AppMetrica telemetry, and turns off Crashlytics/Analytics data collection via their official opt-out flags.

patches.name: Fix Firebase after re-signing
patches.description:
Fixes Firebase services (push notifications, Remote Config, Firebase Auth) that break after Morphe re-signs the app with a different certificate.

Apply with Original app certificate patch — no other config needed.

patches.name: Fix SIM identifier access
patches.description: Replaces the IMSI lookup with the public getSimOperator() call so the pre-login flow passes on Android 11+ where re-signed builds lost carrier privileges ('App Error: NO IMSI'). Falls back to Dialog's 41305 on SIM-less devices.

patches.name: Fix app icon
patches.description: Gives the default launcher icon a real foreground. The base APK ships an adaptive icon with a null foreground (the visible icon normally comes from a theme alias enabled at runtime).

patches.name: Floating power button
patches.description: Adds a draggable quick-actions bubble to the main screen (profile IDs / receipts / pause toggles, copy your profile id, open Pdb Extras). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Quick → 'Show floating power button'.

patches.name: GmsCore support (MicroG)
patches.description:
Routes Google Play Services calls through MicroG instead of real GPS.

Works for: Google apps (YouTube, Maps, News, Photos) and third-party apps using classic Google Sign-In (Android 13 and below).

Does not work for: Android 14+ Credential Manager sign-in (most modern third-party apps), Play Integrity / SafetyNet checks, or apps with custom auth.

Requires MicroG RE installed. Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: MicroG package name
options.description: Which MicroG / GmsCore app is installed on your device. Check your device's app list for "MicroG" or "GmsCore" if unsure — most users should leave this as the default.

options.title: Main activity class (optional)
options.description: The app's main Activity class name ending with a semicolon, e.g. /MainActivity; Used to inject the MicroG check at startup. Leave blank for auto-detection.

options.title: Custom package name (optional)
options.description: Rename the app to this package name. Leave blank to keep the original. Must be a valid package name (e.g. com.example.myapp).

patches.name: Inspect HTTPS traffic (adb reverse proxy)
patches.description: Routes RN network traffic through 127.0.0.1:8080 on the device (adb reverse tunnel to mitmproxy). Off by default; needs the tunnel and a trusted CA.

patches.name: Kill residual beacon traffic
patches.description: Silences the Facebook SDK's remaining phone-home: app-event uploads (/activities, /app) and the SDK config fetch (mobile_sdk_gk). The SDK class init stays alive (required by RN); only transmission dies.

patches.name: No profile-visitor limit
patches.description: Lifts Pdb's client-side cap of 3 profile-visitor views per hour (the 'slow down' sheet). Toggle: Pdb Extras → Limits → 'No profile-visitor limit'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is on.

patches.name: Pdb Extras feature menu
patches.description: Adds a Pdb Extras entry to the top of Pdb's Settings screen with toggles, hidden overrides, power tools (preference writer, chat data, identity controls) and a one-tap shortcut to Pdb's native dev screen.

patches.name: Pdb Extras — resources
patches.description: Adds the Pdb Extras entry to the Settings screen and registers the extension components.

patches.name: Provide Original app certificate
patches.description: Automatically reads the signing certificate from the APK you are patching — no original app installed or file provided needed. Only fill the options below if you are patching an APK that was already re-signed (e.g. a previously patched build): in that case point to the original APK file, or enter the certificate manually.

options.title: Path to original APK (if uninstalled)
options.description: Full path to the original APK or .apks bundle. Example: /sdcard/Download/Waze.apks

options.title: Certificate SHA-1 (manual)
options.description: 40-char hex. Found on APKMirror under app signature info.

options.title: Certificate Base64 DER (manual)
options.description: Needed only for Signature spoof patch. Get it with: apksigner verify --print-certs original.apk

patches.name: Remove ads
patches.description: Disables Pdb's ad SDKs (GMS, AppLovin, Vungle, Yandex, Pangle) and turns off in-app ad initialisation.

patches.name: Show profile IDs on names
patches.description: Appends the numeric profile id (#1234567) after every profile name — Soul cards, chat headers, lists. Toggle: Pdb Extras → 'Show profile IDs on names'. The bytecode ships always-on and is inert until the switch is enabled, so the toggle works without rebuilding.

patches.name: Spoof Widevine / DRM level
patches.description:
Reports Widevine L1 (hardware DRM) to apps that check DRM level locally.

Useful for apps that refuse to play HD/4K content on L3 devices or after re-signing.

Does not bypass server-side DRM - Netflix, Disney+ and similar are not affected.

options.title: Widevine security level to report
options.description: L1 = hardware DRM (highest quality). L3 = software only. Default L1.

options.title: HDCP level to report
options.description: HDCP_V2_2 is required for 4K content on most streaming apps.

patches.name: Spoof app signature
patches.description:
Makes the app think its signing certificate is unchanged after Morphe re-signs it.

Useful when an app crashes or shows a tamper warning because it checks its own certificate.

Does not bypass Play Integrity / SafetyNet hardware attestation.

Apply with Original app certificate patch.

options.title: Package name override (optional)
options.description: Leave blank — read automatically from the app. Only set this if you changed the app's package name and the patch is using the wrong one.

patches.name: Spoof install source
patches.description:
Makes the app think it was installed from a specific store (default: Google Play).

Useful when an app blocks features or shows errors because it detects it was not installed from the Play Store.

Only affects what the app itself sees - does not change the real system install record.

options.title: Store to impersonate
options.description: Most apps only check for the Google Play Store, so the default is usually correct. Pick from the list, or type any package name directly if your app checks for a different store.

patches.name: Spoof stock signing cert hash
patches.description: Makes NativeUtils.setAppToken() return the stock app's certificate hash instead of the patched build's, so the server-side device/app integrity verdict ('App Error: NO IMSI') is not tripped by the re-signed APK.

patches.name: Unlock Pro
patches.description: Unlocks Pdb Pro: premium badge plus every entitlement (no ads, hide online, unlimited rewinds/extends, super chats, visitors, view requests, virtual travel, extra IRL slots, Power PDB server, Wonder-chat reconnect, AI-friend limits, name colour, chat bubbles).

patches.name: Unlock hidden feature flags
patches.description: Flips the server-sent feature flags showO2A/showO2AShop/showO2ABuy/showUber/showDeleteAccount to true in every API response before the JS sees it, revealing app screens the server hides.
